const.authority_identity: Only matching injective detached marker plus authoritative state; candidate path itself has no authority.
const.normalized_path_rule: Portable ASCII relative slash-separated paths; no empty, absolute, dot, dot-dot, duplicate, or unsorted entry.

const.dry_run_success_definition: dryRunPassed after complete dry-run certificate and postcheck validation outside official results; no official rename and no marker.
const.official_success_definition: authoritative only after official rename, official postcheck and validated detached marker.
const.orphaned_candidate_definition: After outer kill or mutual liveness loss, a candidate path may remain; marker must be absent, state is orphanedNonAuthoritativeCandidate, authority is impossible, and any later janitor is outside this run.
const.postcheck_definition: Independent monitor and watchdog reopen complete candidate and all eight prerequisite certificate records, verify full bytes/path/metadata/tree roots, resource/isolation/state relations, confirm marker absent, and remain before deadline.
const.quarantine_definition: Non-authoritative root with no valid marker; all failure states migrate here after workload kill and cleanup, with cleanup inability itself remaining non-authoritative.

const.freeze: open all entry FDs, full-byte and metadata scan, canonical manifest write, fsync files and directories, atomic commitment install NOREPLACE, parent fsync, reopen compare
const.trust_model: root-only frozen inbox commitment; no claim of cryptographic human signatures

const.execution_authorized_field_semantics: false means no execution is authorized by this contract; a matching external authorization plus previously absent composite ledger key and nonce are mandatory.

ledger.atomic_install: renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE through pre-opened ledger dirfd then fsync parent and reopen full-byte compare
ledger.ledger_key_derivation: SHA256(domain + fixed-width contract_sha256 bytes + implementation_commit bytes + phase byte)
ledger.ledger_key_framing: SHA256(u32be(domain_ASCII_length) || domain_ASCII_bytes || 32 raw bytes decoded from contract_sha256 hex || 20 raw bytes decoded from implementation_commit hex || phase_byte)
ledger.nonce_binding: run_nonce is an immutable field inside the sole composite-key consumption record and must equal the authorization record; no separate nonce index or second atomicity claim

const.framing: u32be(domain ASCII length) || domain ASCII || u64be(8) || for each frozen-order canonical record: u64be(full byte length) || complete canonical JSON bytes including LF
const.hash: SHA256 of exactly the framed bytes; per-record hashes are indexes only

const.full_pipeline_accounting: From outer deadline arm through authorization consumption, archive, stages, certificates, rename, postcheck, marker validation, cleanup, and final executor acknowledgement.
const.memory_peak_formula: outer_deadline_executor memory.peak + workload_parent memory.peak <= 8 GiB; child peaks are attribution only and each must remain under its child hard limit
const.placement: bootstrap_watchdog, monitor, and inner are exact siblings below the empty workload_parent; outer_deadline_executor is outside that parent.

const.equality_semantics: Duplicate-key rejecting canonical parse followed by exact field set and value equality; no defaults, aliases, omissions, subset witnesses, or vacuous predicates.
const.self_reference_policy: record_schema_bundle_sha256 is relation-bound by the v0.4 domain-framed bundle recomputation and is not a const inside the bundle it hashes

const.physical_core_selection: four distinct physical package/core pairs from the launcher's inherited allowed set, lowest CPU per pair, ascending

const.armed_before: authorization consumption, tool/source/archive reads, output writes, monitor/watchdog/inner execution
const.cgroup: outer_deadline_executor outside workload_parent and outside all three role siblings
const.failure_action: single bounded write to pre-opened workload_parent/cgroup.kill with bounded EINTR retry; authority is denied by marker absence and external orchestration observes pidfd/cgroup events
const.failure_record_policy: no executor filesystem record and no writable result/marker/quarantine FD; external observation is diagnostic only
const.implementation_constraint: Frozen minimal executor with all buffers preallocated before arm; after arm its only blocking primitive is epoll_wait on absolute timerfd and watchdog pidfd.

const.host_network_fd_source: watchdog opens the host network namespace before unshare and passes a read-only descriptor solely for the negative setns proof

const.whole_run_policy: NO_GO until v0.4 implementation, all 17 record schema validators, all 46 frozen relation checks, Lean proofs, source/tool/test closure, two reviewers, and phase authorization are frozen and passed.

const.override_policy: v0.4 changes only the frozen inheritance bindings, inbox exact-four closure, R29 exact relation, versioned hashes/conformance, and schemas necessarily affected by those bindings; every other v0.3 gate remains conjunctively identical.
const.path_list_semantics: semantic_override_paths is the exhaustive list of intended semantic changes from v0.3; derived_rebindings is the exhaustive list of coarsely grouped fields whose bytes necessarily change because of versioning, hashing, conformance, verifier identity, or audit metadata. No other v0.3 field may differ.

const.bootstrap_watchdog: 64 MiB sibling owns authorization consumption, record/relation validation, monitor and inner kill fds, independent postcheck, and marker installation.
const.inner: 7680 MiB sibling contains every sandbox/compiler/producer/verifier/stage process and has no host namespace, ledger, results-parent, marker, quarantine, signal-escape, or cgroup-migration handle.
const.monitor: 448 MiB sibling orchestrates source/tool/stage/candidate work but cannot consume authorization or create a marker.
const.outer_deadline_executor: Independent frozen executor outside workload_parent owns the unmodifiable absolute deadline and watchdog pidfd; it can only kill workload_parent and cannot access results or authority markers.
const.trust_boundary: No self-report is a gate. Every record is closed-schema validated and every cross-record relation is recomputed from complete bytes by watchdog; outer executor independently enforces deadline/watchdog survival.

const.dry_run_rule: dry-run output remains outside official results, is independently postchecked, never renamed to official candidate, and cannot have a marker
const.failure_rule: Any failure takes a frozen failure transition, kills workload as applicable, forbids marker, and moves candidate/marker temporary to quarantine; no authoritative-looking path is sufficient.
const.marker_install: watchdog uses frozen marker dirfd, injective path, hidden temp, fsync, renameat2 NOREPLACE, parent fsync, reopen full-byte/metadata validation

projection_root_framing.const: domain length u32be + domain ASCII + record count u64be + each canonical projection/host record full bytes framed u64be

projection_root_scope.const: host_baseline plus exactly six ordered role_projections canonical complete bytes; projection_root and status fields excluded

source_snapshot_root_framing.const: domain u32be+ASCII then entry count u64be; each normalized path and complete bytes/canonical metadata length-framed; SHA fields are indexes only

source_snapshot_root_scope.const: exact sorted 1921 regular-file path/complete-byte set plus nonempty canonical directory metadata set; content and metadata roots exclude aggregate root/status/count fields

closure_framing.const: domain u32be length + ASCII bytes + descriptor count u64be + each canonical descriptor full bytes framed u64be

closure_root_scope.const: exact frozen primary_tools, dynamic_loader_descriptors and shared_library_descriptors canonical complete descriptors plus underlying complete file bytes; closure_root/status/count summary fields excluded

const.framing: SHA256(u32be domain length || domain ASCII || u64be canonical bundle byte length || canonical JSON bundle bytes with LF); external hash excluded

negative_tests: consumption nonce differs from bound authorization nonce
fifth uncommitted or committed inbox entry
repair: single atomic composite ledger key with nonce bound inside record
root-only frozen inbox commitment and identity registry
outer executor outside reserved workload budget
absolute timer and bidirectional death-triggered parent kill
distinct host UID/PID namespace and seccomp signal denial
complete-byte content and canonical metadata framing
exact source archive and complete root-owned snapshot content+metadata closure
six role-keyed runtime projections and host baseline

relations.obligation: Authorization and ContractConformance fields equal frozen contract values; self-referential bundle hash is accepted only through R38 domain-framed recomputation, while contract/schema/implementation/freeze/test/tool bindings equal external frozen bytes.
implementation_author_id, authorization_issuer_id, reviewer_1_id, reviewer_2_id are pairwise distinct and reviewers differ from launcher runtime identity.
Exactly two attestation full-byte hashes equal authorization reviewer_attestation_sha256s; reviewer IDs and other-reviewer cross references are exact.

Recompute ledger_key from exact raw/ASCII framing; ledger_record_path must literally equal root/ledger_key.json, root is root:root 0700, record root:root 0444 nlink1, atomic NOREPLACE/file fsync/parent fsync/reopen full-byte equality hold, and the composite key has one record.
Consumption run_nonce equals the authorization run_nonce and is immutable inside the sole composite-key record; no second atomic nonce index is claimed.
frozen_fd_verification_monotonic_raw_ns <= consumed_at and outer deadline start <= frozen FD verification; consumption precedes monitor spawn.

Outer executor is outside workload_parent, holds watchdog pidfd and absolute timer, remains live through postcheck; executor death is detected by watchdog which kills parent, while watchdog death or expiry is detected by executor which kills parent.
workload_parent memory.max=8556380160, pids.max=280, oom.group=1; exact child sums equal parent, executor reserve=33554432, and executor peak plus parent peak never exceeds 8589934592.

Isolation certificate contains six ordered role projections whose namespace, complete read/write/forbidden FD classes, cgroup, exclusive mount and signal fields equal the frozen matrix; watchdog explicitly holds deadline_executor_pidfd distinct from control FD.
UID/GID maps equal frozen maps, host root unmapped, executor/watchdog host UIDs and PID namespaces distinct, all caps empty, NNP=1 and seccomp signal syscalls return EPERM.
Host-net FD is passed only to one-shot probe, setns returns EPERM, all copies close before stage exec, and every role projection reports zero matching host-net inode FDs.
For each stage: supervisor pidfd exit time < freeze request <= frozen observation <= residual snapshot < cgroup removal.
Each stage has exactly four distinct worker PIDs, all concurrently live during a nonempty interval, each assigned two distinct pairs, and union is exactly 0..7 with no overlap.
After supervisor exit, frozen residual cgroup snapshot has populated=0 and zero PIDs; only then are outputs snapshotted and cgroup removed.
Stage set root is recomputed from complete canonical bytes of exactly producer, verifier_a, verifier_b certificates in frozen order using length framing.
file_count=len(files)>0, directory_count=len(directories)>0, path_count=sum, paths are disjoint/unique/sorted, and logical_bytes=sum file byte lengths.
fsynced_file_count=file_count, fsynced_directory_count=directory_count, every entry and root parent are fsynced, uid/gid/mode/nlink/kind exact, and forbidden link/special counts zero.
Content and metadata roots are recomputed from complete bytes and canonical metadata using frozen framing; combined root binds both with its domain.

Primary tools equal exact 11 descriptors including bwrap; role/path keys and library keys are unique, arrays/counts nonempty and equal, recursive loader/library closure and complete-byte framing recompute.
Frozen archive constants, safe extraction, full snapshot path/byte equality, root uid/gid/mode/link/fsync/content/metadata roots, and separate E2 subtree complete-byte equality all hold.
All three semantic reports pass and recomputed counts are 8/8 collision pairs, 16 memberships/certificates, with complete-byte verifier agreement.

Postcheck required-certificate-set root is recomputed from exactly eight canonical full-byte records in frozen order (ContractConformance plus seven); liveness is a separate validated prerequisite and all indexes match.

renamedCandidate exists at the deterministic candidate path with no marker; monitor and watchdog independently reopen and compare all bytes/paths/metadata/roots while outer executor is live before transition to postchecked.
Candidate and marker paths are strict normalized fixed-segment encodings of the same tuple; no empty/dot/trailing component and tuple-to-path injectivity is recomputed without hash injectivity.
Marker authorization, consumption, postcheck, certificate-set, candidate-root, deadline and run tuple fields equal validated records; marker is official-only.

Marker root is root:root 0700; marker file root:root 0444 nlink1; hidden temporary/file/parent fsync, atomic NOREPLACE, reopen complete-byte equality and full stat metadata equality all precede authoritative.

For each phase, every allowed operational source and event tag has exactly one explicit first-hop target; dry_run reaches dryRunPassed without official rename/marker, official alone may reach authoritative, outer-kill failures reach orphaned non-authoritative state, and no failure reaches authority.
A candidate path, rename, validation or receipt has no authority; authoritative iff the matching injective detached marker is valid and state is authoritative.

Authorization inbox has exactly four entries and entry_count=len(entries)=authorization_entry_count+attestation_entry_count+identity_registry_entry_count=1+2+1=4; those exact full bytes are one authorization, two distinct attestations and one identity registry in the root-owned frozen commitment.
outer executor memory.peak + workload_parent memory.peak <= 8GiB; 32MiB is reserved from parent budget, exact child maxima sum to 8160MiB parent max, and all actual peaks respect hard limits.
deadline_start <= FD freeze <= authorization consumption <= first operational byte <= every stage event <= postcheck <= marker validation <= absolute deadline, and ceil wall <=1800.
temporary allocated bytes equal measured dedicated-scope st_blocks*512, include every work/stage/worker scope, and remain <= frozen temporary maximum.

For official, resource published logical/allocated bytes equal artifact byte_length and st_blocks_512*512 sums and are positive; for dry_run both official published values are zero while dry artifact tree remains nonempty.
Outer executor, parent, watchdog, monitor and inner oom/oom_kill/oom_group_kill deltas are all zero from frozen baselines through authority or quarantine.
Measured cpuset.cpus.effective is the same exact four CPUs for parent and all children; four package:core pairs are distinct, mems effective equal, and no role rewrites affinity/cpuset.

Liveness certificate proves distinct executor/watchdog host UIDs, PID namespaces, mutual signal EPERM seccomp probes, bidirectional pidfd ownership, both live at postcheck, and isolated death probes kill parent.
role_matrix_sha256 is recomputed only as SHA256(u32be domain length || domain ASCII || u64be canonical rows length || canonical JSON rows with LF); no self field participates.
All embedded record schemas check against Draft 2020-12 and every nested/top-level $id is globally unique in the bundle.
Every artifact, inbox, candidate and marker relative component obeys strict nonempty no-dot no-double-slash no-trailing-slash grammar and all path sets are byte-unique/sorted.

Source snapshot has exactly 1921 sorted unique regular-file entries plus a nonempty directory metadata set; roots are recomputed from scoped complete file bytes and file/directory metadata excluding aggregate fields, with ownership, modes, links, blocks and fsync exact.

Tool closure root scope is exactly primary/loaders/libraries descriptors and complete underlying bytes, excludes root/status/count summaries, uses domain length framing, and all role/path/library keys are unique.
Runtime role projections show only per-monitor, per-stage-supervisor or per-worker exclusive writable mounts; unassigned scopes and global /work,/publish-stage are absent or recursively read-only.
After outer executor kill, no in-run actor is assumed to quarantine; marker absence and orphanedNonAuthoritativeCandidate are terminal non-authority, and later janitor is outside run.
Exactly eight canonical full-byte certificate records in frozen order are u64be length-framed under the frozen domain; record hashes and the root field itself are excluded from root inputs.
Isolation projection root is recomputed from host baseline and exactly six ordered role projection full bytes with frozen domain/framing; aggregate root/status fields are excluded.

dry_run postcheck requires no official path/rename/marker and terminates dryRunPassed; official postcheck requires renamedCandidate/results fsync and only official can install marker and reach authoritative.

const.framing: SHA256(u32be domain length || domain ASCII || u64be canonical relation-protocol byte length || canonical JSON relation-protocol bytes with LF); external hash excluded

const.executor_death_action: watchdog writes workload_parent/cgroup.kill, thereby killing itself and all workload descendants; no marker

const.dependency_binding: The complete commit archive is authoritative for v0.4/v0.5 dependencies and P0 files; extracted E2 file bytes are independently compared with the separately frozen E2 subtree archive.
const.launcher_source_freeze: required after implementation and before any execution; must bind launcher source commit, contract/schema hashes, test hashes, all external tool descriptors, shared-library closure, and kernel/runtime identity
const.snapshot_closure_required: Complete full-archive path set, file bytes, root-owned modes/link types, fsync state, content root and metadata root must be certified.

source_freeze_snapshot.copy_rule: read once, hash the same byte buffer, write exclusive private snapshot, fsync, rehash snapshot, and never reread mutable workspace

const.concurrency_witness: A nonempty CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW interval [start,end] with start<end during which all four distinct worker pidfds are live and all four host PIDs are members of the same named stage cgroup.
const.daemon_escape_policy: Any stage PID outside the assigned stage cgroup, any residual after supervisor exit, or any worker not witnessed concurrently is terminal residual NO-GO.
sequence_exact: observe stage supervisor exit through pidfd
require populated=0 and zero residual PIDs

const.framing: SHA256(u32be domain length || domain ASCII || u64be canonical state-machine byte length || canonical JSON state-machine bytes with LF); external hash excluded

const.authority_iff_state_and_marker: state=authoritative iff marker is installed, parent-fsynced, reopened, full-byte validated, and injectively addressed to the same run tuple

const.framing: domain length u32be + domain bytes + entry count u64be; each entry is kind byte + normalized path length u32be + path bytes + payload length u64be + complete payload bytes + canonical metadata length u32be + canonical metadata bytes
const.stage_root_framing: stage-set domain followed by exactly three canonical stage certificate byte strings in frozen order, each framed by u64be byte length; hashes alone are insufficient

executable_verifier_must_recompute: every frozen relation_protocol obligation; relation_count is exact for v0.3 and not an upper bound for later versions
cross-record identity inequality and hash equality
four-worker concurrency and exact pair-set partition
lean_must_prove: authoritative implies every exact conformance field and all relation certificates
candidate and marker tuple-to-path encodings are injective over their fixed grammars
detached marker is necessary and sufficient for authority under the frozen protocol

const.included_until: validated marker reopen and executor success acknowledgement, or bounded kill/quarantine failure terminal

const.success_condition: watchdog independently validates all record schemas and relations, completes postcheck, installs and reopens injective detached marker, then acknowledges outer executor
const.watchdog_death_action: outer_deadline_executor kills workload_parent and no marker can be created
